distortion.note: An unknown 2nd-order polynomial distortion displaces each marker from its ideal grid position. For each spatial axis, the displacement is a linear combination of the listed quadratic terms evaluated at the ideal position coordinates (in mm).

fields.detected_markers: Array of objects, one per matched marker. Each has: grid_id (3-element int list [i,j,k]), ideal_position_mm (3-element float list), detected_position_mm (3-element float list), displacement_mm (3-element float list, detected minus ideal), displacement_magnitude_mm (float, L2 norm of displacement vector)
fields.num_detected: Integer count of successfully detected and matched markers
fields.geometric_errors: Object with: max_mm (float), mean_mm (float), rms_mm (float) — statistics of displacement_magnitude_mm across all markers
fields.distortion_model: Object with: coefficients_x (6-element float list), coefficients_y (6-element float list), coefficients_z (6-element float list) — polynomial coefficients in order matching the terms field; fit_residual_rms_mm (float, RMS of residuals after polynomial fit)
fields.snr_db: Float, contrast-to-noise ratio in dB computed as 20*log10((mean_marker_intensity - mean_background_intensity) / std_background_intensity)
fields.quality_assessment: Object with: detection_pass (bool), geometric_pass (bool), snr_pass (bool), overall (string, 'PASS' if all criteria met, 'FAIL' otherwise)
